speaking_coach.name: Speaking Coach
speaking_coach.tagline: Speak freely with AI coaches of different accents and expertise
speaking_coach.value_prop: Speak freely in English with AI coaches of different accents and expertise. Pronunciation, grammar and vocabulary errors are analyzed in real time.
how_to: Open Speaking Coach from the Sphere AI Studio menu
Pick the coach that fits your industry or target accent (e.g. British CEO, New York finance expert, Indian-English software developer)
Grant microphone access and start speaking with the coach
Review the feedback that appears during and after the conversation
speaking_coach.target_level: B1 and above — professionals who want to adapt to different accents and practice fluent speaking
speaking_coach.first_action: Pick the coach closest to your industry and talk about your work for 2 minutes

pronunciation_coach.name: Speaking Coach
pronunciation_coach.tagline: Speak freely with AI coaches of different accents and expertise
pronunciation_coach.value_prop: Speak freely in English with AI coaches of different accents and expertise. Pronunciation, grammar and vocabulary errors are analyzed in real time.
how_to: Open Speaking Coach from the Sphere AI Studio menu
Pick the coach that fits your industry or target accent (e.g. British CEO, New York finance expert, Indian-English software developer)
Grant microphone access and start speaking with the coach
Review the feedback that appears during and after the conversation
pronunciation_coach.target_level: B1 and above — professionals who want to adapt to different accents and practice fluent speaking
pronunciation_coach.first_action: Pick the coach closest to your industry and talk about your work for 2 minutes

speaking_scenes.name: Speaking Scenes
speaking_scenes.tagline: Role-play with AI in 66 ready-made business scenarios
speaking_scenes.value_prop: Role-play with AI in 66 ready-made business scenarios. Each target sentence you say is scored for pronunciation, fluency, accuracy and completeness.
how_to: Open Speaking Scenes
Pick a category (Phone, Sales, Meetings, Negotiation, Presentations, HR, etc.)
Click 'Start' on a scene that matches your level
Play your role, say each turn's target sentence and see your score
speaking_scenes.target_level: A2 and above — for those preparing for concrete business situations (calls, meetings, sales)
speaking_scenes.first_action: Complete an A2 scene from the Phone category

writing_coach.name: Writing Coach
writing_coach.tagline: Let AI analyze the English you write
writing_coach.value_prop: AI analyzes your English text and gives you feedback to improve.
how_to: Open Writing Coach
Choose the writing type (General Writing, Business Email, Formal Letter, Essay, Report)
Optionally enter a topic or title
Write or paste your text (up to 3,000 characters)
Click 'Analyze Text' and review the feedback
writing_coach.target_level: A2 and above — anyone writing business emails, reports or exam essays
writing_coach.first_action: Paste a business email you sent this week and get it analyzed

grammar_coach.name: Grammar Coach
grammar_coach.tagline: Learn and practice grammar tailored to your level
grammar_coach.value_prop: Learn and practice grammar topics organized by level with AI guidance.
how_to: Open Grammar Coach
Pick your level at the top (A1–C1)
Click a topic, read the explanation and do the exercises
Watch the topic status update to 'completed'
grammar_coach.target_level: A1–C1 — for those strengthening grammar foundations or closing gaps on specific topics
grammar_coach.first_action: Open the first unstarted topic at your level and complete it

vocab_game.name: Vocab Game
vocab_game.value_prop: Grow your vocabulary by playing an AI-powered word-guessing game.
how_to: Open Vocab Game
Enter your name
Pick a level (single level or Mixed)
Start the game and guess the words
vocab_game.target_level: All levels — for quick, fun daily practice
vocab_game.first_action: Play a round at your level

simulation_mode.name: Business Simulations
simulation_mode.tagline: Role-play industry scenarios with expert AI coaches
simulation_mode.value_prop: Role-play industry-specific business scenarios with expert AI coaches.
how_to: Open Business Simulations
Pick your industry (Finance, Tech, Healthcare, Tourism, Legal, etc.)
Pick a scenario and coach specific to the industry
Complete the scenario end-to-end with the coach
simulation_mode.target_level: B1 and above — professionals wanting to practice in the language of their industry
simulation_mode.first_action: Pick your own industry and try the first scenario

interview_sim.name: Interview Simulator
interview_sim.tagline: Voice interview with AI + detailed hiring report
interview_sim.value_prop: Practice English job interviews via voice with an AI interviewer and receive a detailed hiring-style report at the end.
how_to: Open Interview Simulator
Enter target position, seniority (Junior to Executive) and industry
Optionally add the job ad and CV summary
Choose the number of questions (Quick 4 / Standard 8 / Detailed 12)
Pick your interviewer and start the voice interview
Review the hiring-style report at the end
interview_sim.target_level: B1 and above — candidates preparing for English interviews or international jobs
interview_sim.first_action: Enter the position you want and try 'Quick (4 questions)' mode

presentation_sim.name: Presentation Simulator
presentation_sim.tagline: Present in English + manage Q&A, get impact + language report
presentation_sim.value_prop: Deliver English presentations to a chosen audience and manage the Q&A round. Get an impact + language report at the end.
how_to: Open Presentation Simulator
Write your topic, pick the purpose (Inform, Persuade, Pitch, Train, Update)
Set tone, target duration, and Q&A count
Pick your audience (Investors, Board, Internal Team, Customers)
Deliver the presentation, then handle the audience's questions
Review the impact and language report
presentation_sim.target_level: B1 and above — professionals delivering meeting, pitch or customer presentations
presentation_sim.first_action: Rehearse a real upcoming presentation in a 5-minute version

ai_quiz.name: AI Quiz
ai_quiz.tagline: Write a topic or paste text, AI builds a personalized quiz
ai_quiz.value_prop: Get AI to build a personalized quiz to measure your level based on a topic you write or text you paste.
how_to: Open AI Quiz
Enter a topic or paste an English text as the source
Pick your level (A1–C2)
Pick question types (Vocabulary, Grammar, Comprehension)
Set question count (4-20) and click 'Generate Quiz'
ai_quiz.target_level: All levels — for reinforcing a text you read or testing yourself on a topic
ai_quiz.first_action: Paste an article you read in Explore and generate an 8-question quiz

ai_tutor.name: Personal AI Tutor
ai_tutor.tagline: Your personal English tutor who remembers you
ai_tutor.value_prop: Your personal English tutor who teaches you through conversation and remembers your past chats. Explanations come with Turkish support when needed.
how_to: Open Personal AI Tutor
Click 'New Chat'
Type your question (grammar, vocabulary, writing, exam prep, etc.)
Continue the conversation with the explanations and examples; revisit past chats from the left panel
ai_tutor.target_level: All levels — anyone who wants instant answers to what they're stuck on
ai_tutor.first_action: Ask about an English phrase or grammar rule you're curious about today

learning_path.name: Learning Path
learning_path.value_prop: Get AI to build you a personalized 4-week study plan based on your activity, weak areas and goal.
how_to: Open Learning Path
Set your goal and generate your plan
Follow the weekly plan broken down into daily steps
Check off completed steps; use 'Regenerate Plan' if needed
learning_path.target_level: All levels — for structured, goal-oriented study
learning_path.first_action: Complete this week's first step of your plan

level_exams.name: Level Exams
level_exams.tagline: CEFR level-up — based on Oxford Business Result
level_exams.value_prop: Proficiency exams based on Oxford Business Result for every CEFR level — measure and level up.
how_to: Open Level Exams
See your current level and unlocked exams
Click 'Start Exam' at a level and answer the questions
Score 70%+ to level up and unlock the next exam
level_exams.target_level: All levels — for officially benchmarking or leveling up
level_exams.first_action: Take your current level's exam to validate your starting point

materials.name: Materials
materials.value_prop: Oxford-referenced business English materials, PDFs, audio files — all downloadable for offline use.
how_to: Pick a material suitable for your level
Read online or download
Go at your own pace
materials.first_action: Browse categories and pick a starter material

speaking_club.name: Speaking Club
speaking_club.tagline: Live speaking events with real people
speaking_club.value_prop: Sign up for English speaking events organized with other participants.
how_to: Open Speaking Club
Browse upcoming events
Sign up for an event that fits you
Track your registrations in the 'My Registrations' tab and join when the time comes
speaking_club.target_level: A2 and above — for building confidence by speaking with real people
speaking_club.first_action: Sign up for one of the upcoming events

live_classes.name: Live Classes
live_classes.tagline: Live group classes with Sphere instructors
live_classes.value_prop: Regular weekly live classes. Small group (max 6), interactive, recordings available.
how_to: Pick a suitable class from your schedule
Click Join
Watch replay after class if needed

discover.name: Explore
discover.tagline: News and articles by level + Turkish summary
discover.value_prop: Read level-tagged current news and articles with Turkish summaries. Content is personalized to your industry.
how_to: Pick your industry from the dashboard
Open Explore
Pick an article at your level, check the Turkish summary, and read it
discover.target_level: A2 and above — for improving reading skills and business vocabulary
discover.first_action: Read an article related to your own industry

watch_listen.name: Watch & Listen
watch_listen.tagline: Sharpen listening with videos and podcasts
watch_listen.value_prop: Sharpen your listening with videos and podcasts on productivity, motivation and the business world. Every piece comes with a Turkish summary.
how_to: Open Watch & Listen
Pick a piece of content that interests you and check the Turkish summary
Watch the video or listen to the podcast
watch_listen.target_level: B1 and above — for adapting to natural speaking speed and different accents
watch_listen.first_action: Watch one of this week's recommended videos
